plugins.readme_text:
# ZadLoop Ultimate Toolkit **One tarball. Eight integrated tools. No plugin hunting.** ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-2.0.2-7c8cff?style=flat-square) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-45c992?style=flat-square) ![ZadLoop](https://img.shields.io/badge/ZadLoop-0.5.1-ff7a90?style=flat-square) ![Offline bundle](https://img.shields.io/badge/install-offline_bundle-f4c45e?style=flat-square) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/Lucifer-xD/zadloop-ultimate-toolkit/ci.yml?style=flat-square&label=tests)](https://github.com/Lucifer-xD/zadloop-ultimate-toolkit/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
ZadLoop Ultimate Toolkit packages subscription OAuth, live remaining plan quota, authenticated Remote Control, Computer Use, Context Surgery, same-session Undo, live session mode switching, full chat transfer, and Theme Studio into **one self-contained plugin file**. Its dependencies are bundled inside the release, so your friends install a single `.tgz` rather than finding separate packages. > Community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek or ZadLoop. ## What is included | Feature | What it does | Included version | |---|---|---:| | OAuth Subscriptions | The unmodified `dsh-plugin-oauth-subs` workbench for Codex/ChatGPT, Grok, GLM, Kiro, Antigravity, Cursor, Ollama Cloud, Kimi, Devin, Cline, Command Code, and OpenCode Go, with accounts, quota, models, and usage | 0.0.121 | | Toolkit UI | Shows the connected plan's 5-hour and weekly quota remaining beside the composer controls, opens a quick inline summary on click, modernizes the subscription workbench, and repairs the Transfer and Delegate icons | 1.0.3 | | Remote Control | Create a secure internet link in one click, with a responsive Liquid Glass control panel and login, or use local-only, LAN/IP, and custom Cloudflare domain modes | 2.2.4 | | Computer Use | Let a vision-capable agent manage its own access and operate the visible Windows desktop with screenshots, mouse, keyboard, scrolling, and an expiring timer | 1.1.1 | | Context Surgery | Edit reply text, edit reasoning separately, remove messages from future model context, and use `/context` commands | 0.1.2 fixed-v4 | | Same-session Undo | Remove one user/assistant exchange from the transcript and future context without creating a new session | 1.5.1 | | Mode Switcher | Change the **current session** between Standard and Delegate mode | 2.0.3 | | Session Transfer | Export/import, fast-forward-sync, or safely preserve both branches of a forked chat | 1.2.0 | | Theme Studio | 51 dark + 21 light mode-exclusive themes, including Apple-inspired functional Liquid Glass layers, detailed controls, and a live preview | 5.3.0 | | Offline dependencies | Bundled runtime packages, including `fflate`; no npm lookup is required during tarball installation | bundled | ![Compact toolbar with Themes, Mode, and Transfer](docs/images/toolbar.svg) ## Install ### ZadLoop interface 1. Download [`dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit-2.0.2.tgz`](https://github.com/Lucifer-xD/zadloop-ultimate-toolkit/releases/latest/download/dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit-2.0.2.tgz) from the latest GitHub release. 2. If standalone copies are installed, disable or uninstall these first to avoid duplicate buttons: - `@wasd258/dsh-context-surgery` - `dsh-zadloop-undo` - `dsh-zadloop-mode-switcher` - `dsh-zadloop-computer-use` - `dsh-plugin-oauth-subs` - `dsh-zadloop-remote-control` - `dsh-zadloop-theme-studio` - `dsh-zadloop-session-transfer` 3. Open **Plugins → Add plugin → Tarball**. 4. Select the downloaded toolkit `.tgz`. 5. Let ZadLoop hot-load it. Restart only if your ZadLoop build explicitly asks you to. ### Command line ```powershell cd "$env:APPDATA\ZadLoop\harness\profiles\web" pnpm add "C:\path\to\dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit-2.0.2.tgz" ``` Add `dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit` once to `dsh.profile.bundles` if your package manager does not do that automatically. ## Feature guide ### OAuth Subscriptions and live plan quota Open **Subscriptions** in the sidebar to manage accounts, quotas, models, usage, and provider settings through the bundled `dsh-plugin-oauth-subs` workbench. The toolkit keeps the upstream plugin's authentication and token handling unchanged. A compact plan control now sits with Themes, Transfer, and the session-mode control under the composer. It automatically finds the connected subscription provider exposing rolling limits and shows its **5-hour** and **weekly** percentages remaining directly in the dock. Clicking it opens a small glass summary with two progress lines without leaving the chat. Low remaining quota is highlighted without changing any authentication or provider behavior. The workbench has toolkit-scoped visual improvements for clearer cards, provider navigation, active states, spacing, and small-screen behavior. The same presentation layer replaces the malformed Transfer and Delegate graphics with fixed 14px outline icons without touching other ZadLoop icons. ### Remote Control Open **Remote** in the bottom dock and click **Create secure remote link**. The plugin automatically: 1. Detects Cloudflare Tunnel or installs it silently through Windows Package Manager. 2. Generates a strong access code and stores only its salted hash. 3. Starts a temporary encrypted Quick Tunnel. 4. Shows one **Copy link + code** button for sharing the invite. No domain, Cloudflare account, router configuration, port forwarding, or manual password creation is needed. Advanced setup remains available for these connection modes: - **Local browser** listens only on `127.0.0.1`; a password is optional. - **LAN / IP** makes ZadLoop available to devices on the same network and requires a passphrase. - **Quick Tunnel** creates a temporary `trycloudflare.com` address and requires a passphrase. - **Custom domain** runs an existing Cloudflare named tunnel using its UUID, hostname, and credentials file. Click **Save & start**, then copy the live URL. A signed-in remote browser receives the complete ZadLoop interface: chats, settings, plugins, Theme Studio, transfer, mode switching, and agent tools. The toolbar shows active sessions; **Revoke sessions** disconnects them immediately and **Stop remote access** closes the listener and tunnel. Remote access is off after first installation. Passphrases are stored only as salted scrypt hashes. Network modes cannot be started without one, login attempts are rate-limited, and the private local ZadLoop browser credential is never sent to a visitor. Quick/custom tunnel modes bind only to loopback; LAN mode does not create a firewall rule automatically. ![Remote Control setup panel](docs/images/remote-control.svg) ### Computer Use Ask for a desktop task naturally. The agent uses `computer_access` to enable control when needed, operates through screenshots, then can pause access when finished. **Computer** in the bottom dock still provides live status, manual 15–120 minute controls, and **Pause now** for terminating an in-flight action. Then ask naturally, for example: - “Open Settings and enable Night light.” - “Use the browser to download my latest invoice.” - “Open this spreadsheet and sort the table by date.” The model receives a new screenshot after every action and can move, click, double-click, right-click, drag, scroll, type Unicode text, and press shortcuts such as `CTRL+L` or `ALT+TAB`. Coordinates remain accurate on scaled and multi-monitor desktops. ![Computer Use control center](docs/images/computer-use.svg) Use a vision-capable model. Supervise consequential work and pause before passwords, payments, account changes, or other sensitive actions. ### Context Surgery Use the actions under an assistant message: - **Edit reply** changes visible reply text while preserving reasoning and tool calls. - **Edit reasoning** changes only the reasoning stream. - **Remove** shadows that message from the model-visible context through an append-only surface replacement. - `/context list`, `/context edit`, `/context thin

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的 API 价格时段提醒：当前处于空闲时段还是高峰时段、距离切换还有多久，以及当前生效的价目表。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-price-tip — DeepSeek 价格时段提醒

*[English](README.en.md) · 中文*

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：在 Web 界面**侧栏底部**常驻一个价格时段标记，显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于
**空闲时段**还是**高峰时段**、距下次切换还有多久；点开是规则说明、当前生效的价目表，以及已登录
DeepSeek 账户的余额。

![侧栏底部的标记](docs/screenshot-sidebar.png)

*侧栏底部实拍：绿色月牙 = 空闲时段，状态文案旁是绿色口号，右侧为距下次切换的倒计时。*

![点击标记展开的面板](docs/screenshot-panel.png)

*点击展开：当前时段与折扣、剩余时间与切换时刻（本机时区、跟随界面语言）、口号、账户余额（充值/赠送余额、
更新时间、刷新与去充值）、价目表（加粗为当前价、划线为高峰价），以及底部的规则与来源。深色主题下的侧栏与面板见
[docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)。*

## 它提醒什么

| 时段 | 北京时间 | 价格 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 高峰 | 周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日） | 标准价 |
| 空闲 | 其余全部时间，含周末与法定节假日全天 | 高峰价的 50% |

> ⚠️ 2025 年那套「00:30–08:30 错峰优惠」已于 2025-09-05 取消，`deepseek-chat` / `deepseek-reasoner`
> 也已于 2026-07-24 下线——**都不是现行规则**。规则与价目表以
> [DeepSeek 官方价格页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing) 为准（核对于 2026-10-10）。

## 特性

- **随日历走**：周末与法定节假日整天空闲；内置 2026 年落在工作日的 19 个节假日，日历未覆盖的年份标注「按工作日估算」。
- **余额**：展开面板即读一次已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额（充值余额、赠送余额，两位小数 + 千分位，与「设置 → 账户」同口径），
  附更新时间、手动刷新与「去充值」入口。走 DSH 账户自身的 Remote 命名空间，插件**不接触任何密钥**；
  未登录时只显示一行提示，没有账户控制器的配置档则整个区块隐藏。只在打开面板时读取，不做轮询。
- **情绪价值**：空闲时段喊你「站起来蹬」，高峰时段提醒你「心疼着蹬」——侧栏那一行直接就能看到，点开还有完整一句「便宜时段，尽管使劲用」/「贵时段，蹬一下心疼一下」。
- **中英双语**：文案走 Harness 的 locale 命名空间，切换界面语言即时生效。
- **零依赖、免构建**：`client.js` 已提交进仓库，装上即用；Host 半边不注册任何工具或会话状态。
- **可自改**：规则、节假日与价目表在 `src/policy.js`，余额格式化与状态机在 `src/balance.js`，改完重建即可，见 [docs/development.md](docs/development.md)。

## 如何安装

插件零依赖、无生命周期脚本，且**已提交构建产物**，因此安装时不需要任何构建步骤。
下面三条路径都在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 上实测过（验证记录见 [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)）。

| 路径 | 操作 | 适用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **GitHub**（推荐） | **设置 → 插件** → 粘贴 `https://github.com/hojas/dsh-price-tip` | 一般使用 |
| **tarball** | `pnpm pack` 后，在安装框粘贴 `.tgz` 的绝对路径 | 离线 / 内网 / 锁版本 |
| **本地目录** | `git clone` 后，在安装框粘贴该目录的绝对路径 | 要改代码 |

前两条拿到的只有运行时文件与文档（无 `src/`、`scripts/`、`test/`）；要改规则请用本地目录方式。
命令行等价写法（仅限非 `desktop` 配置档）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/hojas/dsh-price-tip
```

### 安装须知

- **桌面版只能走界面**：`desktop` 配置档由 Electron 独占，命令行会拒绝
  （`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。
- **装完刷新页面**：客户端 bundle 由 HMR 追加进引导图，刷新可确保生效。
- **本地目录装的是软链**（`link:`）：改完 `node scripts/build-client.mjs` 刷新即可，不必重装。
- **版本耦合**：样式只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，槽位是 `sidebar.footer.action`，并由 `dsh.client.inject`
  依赖 DSH 自带的 sidebar 与 locale 客户端包；余额通过**可选**的 `remote.account` 命名空间读取
  （没有账户控制器的配置档自动隐藏该区块）；DSH 改槽位名、locale API 或账户 Remote 时需跟着调整。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [docs/development.md](docs/development.md) | 文件结构、自定义规则、规则来源与边界假设、设计取舍、构建与测试 |
| [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md) | 验证状态：实测项、截图、未验证项、验证方法 |

plugins.description: Incrementally archive DeepSeek Harness sessions into a self-hosted WeKnora knowledge base: extract, summarize, dedupe, upload. DSH 会话归档进 WeKnora 知识库。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-weknora-archive **中文** · [English](#english) 把 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）会话**增量归档**进 [WeKnora](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora) 知识库的 host 端插件。是官方只读插件 `@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora`（4 个检索工具）的**写入侧互补**。 ## 功能 | 工具 | 说明 | |---|---| | `weknora_archive_session` | 归档某个项目的 DSH 会话：定位会话目录 → 解压 `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` → 提取对话 → 启发式总结（模板：主题/决策/产出/细节/遗留）→ 按文档标题去重后上传；知识库不存在时按项目名自动新建；首次归档附 `00_项目总览.md`；支持 `dry_run` 预览 | | `weknora_archive_status` | 只读：列出本机会话项目目录与会话数，查看目标知识库内已归档文档与解析状态 | | `weknora_archive_list_knowledge_bases` | 只读：列出该凭据可见的知识库 | | `weknora_archive_create_knowledge_base` | 新建知识库（注意：新建库可能需在 WeKnora 端配置 embedding 模型，否则文档解析失败） | 工具名前缀可通过 `toolPrefix` 配置（默认 `weknora_archive`）。工具描述中英双语。 ## 安装 ```bash node "/Applications/DSH Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/app/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" \ plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-weknora-archive ``` ## 配置 走 DSH 官方插件配置机制：插件 bundle 自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，默认从环境变量读取（**key 不落地、不入库**）： | 字段 | 环境变量 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `baseUrl` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_BASE_URL` | WeKnora 部署地址（裸域名或 `/api/v1` 结尾均可），如 `http://weknora.example.com` | | `apiKey` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_API_KEY` | 具备写入/摄取能力的 scoped API key | | `knowledgeBaseId` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_KB_ID` | 可选：固定目标库；缺省按项目名自动匹配/新建 | | `sessionsDir` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_SESSIONS_DIR` | 可选：会话存储根目录；缺省自动探测 `/sessions` | | `maxSummaryChars` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS` | 单篇总结上限（默认 8000） | 也可把 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert 行拷进 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 直接填值（注意文件权限）。 ## 隐私说明 - 会话数据**只发往你自己配置的 WeKnora 实例**，插件不经过任何第三方服务。 - API key 只用于请求头 `X-API-Key`，**绝不写入日志、异常信息、工具结果或本文档**；日志输出前统一走 `redactConfig()` 脱敏。 - 总结为**启发式规则生成（无 LLM 参与）**，凭据类内容不收录完整值。 ## API 兼容性 认证头为 `X-API-Key`（非 Bearer），路由中横线风格：`GET/POST /knowledge-bases`、`GET /knowledge-bases/{id}/knowledge`、`POST /knowledge`（multipart 上传 Markdown）、`POST /knowledge/{id}/reparse`。**以你的 WeKnora 实际 API 为准**；若有出入只需调整 `lib/client.js`。 ## 本地单测 ```bash npm test # node test/mock.test.mjs，mock 数据 + mock 客户端，无需网络与凭证 ``` ## 已知边界 - 总结是启发式抽取，不是 LLM 精炼；追求质量可在归档前手工润色。 - 正在运行的会话文件可能解压失败，会被跳过（下次归档自动补上）。 - 新建库的 embedding 配置需在 WeKnora 端完成（PUT 接口会静默丢弃 embedding 字段）。 --- # dsh-weknora-archive (English) A DeepSeek Harness host plugin that **incrementally archives DSH sessions** into a [WeKnora](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora) knowledge base — the write-side complement to the official read-only `@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora` plugin (4 retrieval tools). ## Tools | Tool | Purpose | |---|---| | `weknora_archive_session` | Archive a project's sessions: locate session dirs → decompress `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` → extract conversation → heuristic summarize (topic / decisions / artifacts / hard details / leftovers) → dedupe by document title → upload. Auto-creates the knowledge base by project name when absent; adds a `00_项目总览.md` overview on first run; `dry_run` supported. | | `weknora_archive_status` | Read-only: list local session project dirs with counts, and documents already in a target KB with parse status. | | `weknora_archive_list_knowledge_bases` | Read-only: list visible knowledge bases. | | `weknora_archive_create_knowledge_base` | Create a KB (a fresh KB may need an embedding model configured on the WeKnora side). | Prefix is configurable via `toolPrefix` (default `weknora_archive`). Tool descriptions are bilingual (EN/中文). ## Install ```bash node "/Applications/DSH Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/app/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" \ plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-weknora-archive ``` ## Configuration Uses DSH's official plugin-config mechanism: the bundle ships a `cordis.patch.yml` that reads environment variables by default (**no key hardcoded anywhere**): | Field | Env var | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `baseUrl` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_BASE_URL` | Your WeKnora deployment root or `/api/v1` root (placeholder in this repo — set your own) | | `apiKey` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_API_KEY` | Scoped WeKnora API key with ingest capability | | `knowledgeBaseId` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_KB_ID` | Optional fixed target KB; otherwise matched/created per project | | `sessionsDir` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_SESSIONS_DIR` | Optional sessions root; auto-detected when empty | | `maxSummaryChars` | `WEKNORA_ARCHIVE_MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS` | Per-summary cap (default 8000) | Alternatively copy the insert row into your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` with literal values (mind file permissions). ## Privacy - Session data goes **only to the WeKnora instance you configure** — no third-party service involved. - The API key is used solely in the `X-API-Key` header and is **never logged, never embedded in errors, tool results, or this README**; all log paths go through `redactConfig()`. - Summaries are produced by **heuristic rules without any LLM**, and credential-looking values are never recorded in full. ## API compatibility Auth is the `X-API-Key` header (not Bearer); kebab-case routes: `GET/POST /knowledge-bases`, `GET /knowledge-bases/{id}/knowledge`, `POST /knowledge` (multipart Markdown upload), `POST /knowledge/{id}/reparse`. **Defer to your actual WeKnora API**; if it differs, only `lib/client.js` needs changes. ## Tests ```bash npm test # mock data + mock client, no network or credentials required ``` ## Known limits - Summaries are heuristic extractions, not LLM-polished prose. - A live session file may fail to decompress and is skipped (picked up on the next run). - Embedding configuration for newly created KBs must be done on the WeKnora side. ## License MIT

plugins.description: The Coreness kit for DeepSeek Harness — a plugin bundle for a profile.
plugins.readme_text:
# Coreness for DeepSeek Harness **A page, a journal and a brake for a DeepSeek Harness profile.** Coreness is the product for one DeepSeek Harness profile: a page with the profile's MCP servers, its Qoder provider and its rate limits and usage; the journal of what the profile and its sessions do; and the rules of the tree in force. It installs as it is: the halves the browser loads are plain files, served where they lie — nothing is built, nothing is compiled, and what is installed is what runs. ## ⚡ Install **The application installs its own plugins.** *Plugins* → *Add plugin* takes a package name, a tarball, a git address or a local path, and the package goes into the profile the application is running — one door for the desktop application and for the web one, and no profile to name: ``` github:Vensus137/Coreness-DSH ``` The same page switches the package off without removing it, and takes it off again. That address follows the newest release, and what stands published is a release — so the address and the newest release are one thing here. A fixed release is named by its own tag — `…Coreness-DSH#v0.6.4` — and a released tag is never moved: that line gives the same code whenever it is run.
By command line — for a terminal; nothing above needs it The line is ready to run as it stands, because the desktop application's own profile carries that name: ``` dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Vensus137/Coreness-DSH ``` Another profile is named by its own name instead — the web surface's is `web` — and naming a profile that does not stand yet creates it. `dsh` is the application's own command and is not one Windows or macOS comes with, so until the application puts it on the path a terminal answers *not recognized*. The application does that from its own menu: in the window's title bar beside the app icon, **Application** → **Manage dsh Command…** — the dialog shows the location it manages, and the same dialog takes the command off the path again. A terminal opened before that act keeps the path it started with, so open a new one afterwards.
The profile's composition is read when the application starts, so the package becomes live at the next start, and the platform says itself when a change it made needs a restart. Nothing is built on the way in and no permission for install scripts is asked: the package is plain files, and the address is fetched over the network the application already uses rather than by a git client — a machine without git installs it. ### Updates through the market The application has its own **Discover** tab: it reads a plugin market, and the market is a list you add. Turn on *Custom plugin markets* once — **Plugins → More** beside *Experimental plugins* — then add this address in Discover: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vensus137/Coreness-DSH/main/market.json ``` The plugin stands listed with its versions, and the market tells you when a newer one exists: the application compares the versions itself. The market lists and compares; it does not upgrade. Its own note says so — *no upgrade action* — and its **Update available** press only opens the plugin's page. The update is the same act as the install: **Add plugin** with the same address picks up the newest release, and the application says when a restart is needed. A version that does not move after that is a pinned lockfile: take the plugin off and add it again. Nothing checks in the background and nothing notifies — the market is read when the page is opened. A profile that mounts a working tree (`file:` dependency) is the development case: the market's install would replace that mount with the published copy, so a development profile updates by re-mounting instead. ## ✨ What a profile gets - 🗂 **A page of its own** — the profile's MCP servers as cards, its Qoder provider and its rate limits and usage; the sections stand in the rail, and the version stands beside the name. - 🔌 **The MCP servers, seen and edited** — one card per server: its kind, its address, the environment it needs, and switches whose effect lands in the profile rather than in a copy. - 📓 **The journal** — the environment's memory: what changed in the profile and what a participant did, kept as records that carry a kind, an area, a name and an author. - 🚦 **A limiter that waits instead of refusing** — a call over the limit takes its turn in a queue; nothing is limited as the package ships. - 🧠 **A route to the Qoder models** — the account's own models, each with the reasoning levels it accepts and the output budget it allows. The account's token is entered once, in the Qoder section, and kept by the platform's own store; no value of it stands in the package. The credits foot reads the balance while the account is reachable. - 📜 **The rules of its own tree, in force** — one prompt section, registered through the platform's own prompt registry, so a session of the profile carries them in every request and no compaction can take them out of the model's sight. ## 🧩 What it needs - **DeepSeek Harness.** The version this package was built against is declared in the manifest, and the application compares that declaration with its own before a profile imports a plugin: a mismatch leaves the plugin out and says so, instead of failing quietly later. - **A Qoder account,** for the Qoder route and the credits foot; the token is entered in the Qoder section and kept by the platform's own store. ## 📦 What lands Exactly the list the package's manifest names — the bundle and the seven packages, each with its own README beside its code. No part of the workshop they are built in: the contracts, the checks and the notes of this project stay where the work is done. ## 🧭 What it deliberately does not do - It is not a second door to the platform's own acts: enabling, disabling, installing and removing belong to the application's Plugins page, and this package reports what stands rather than competing with it. - It does not own the MCP side: the platform owns the servers, the connection and the registry, while this package owns the picture and the form. - It limits nothing until a limit is declared. ## 📄 License MIT.

plugins.description: DSH 微信通道增强插件 — 集成 iLink 消息双向桥接、单实例锁、大文件智能投递与 Web 设置管理界面
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-weixin-plus

> DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 微信通道全功能增强插件 —— 通用版：跨机器零改配置，装完即用。

把手机微信变成 DSH 的一个入口：微信发消息 → DSH 会话，DSH 回复/发图/发文件 → 微信；并在 DSH 设置中心提供完整的「微信通道」管理面板。

---

## 核心特性

1. **双向消息与媒体桥接**：文本、图片、文件双向传输；入站媒体自动归档。
2. **Web 设置与管理面板**：嵌入 DSH 设置中心「微信通道」标签页 —— 实时探测连通性与 Token 有效期（过期即时预警）、一键重新扫码登录（动态渲染二维码）、一键断开连接并安全清理本地凭证。
3. **免 403 的双通道通讯**：
   - 首选 Cordis `connection.rpc` 通道（`/dsh-weixin-plus`），天然免疫 Electron / 浏览器模式下的安全拦截与鉴权错误；
   - 失败自动回退到独立 HTTP 路由口 `/dsh-weixin-plus-http/<action>`（与 RPC 口分属不同前缀，互不抢占）。
4. **单实例选举锁（`ilink-owner.lock`）**：多宿主（GUI + 后台无头服务）同时运行时只允许一个消费消息，避免游标竞争与丢消息。
5. **大文件智能转接（filepush17）**：超过微信体积限制的本地文件安全暂存后投递。
6. **大图无损智能分流（filepush18 / v1.0.5）**：出站图片 ≤2MB 走图片气泡直显，>2MB 自动无损升维走微信原图文件通道，规避微信 CDN 500 且 100% 保留原始像素；加载时自愈热补丁增强底层 SDK，跨机器零配置。
7. **微信端文字选项提问**：需要用户选择时以 A/B/C 文字选项下发（微信端看不到交互卡片），并把回复解析回选项。

---

## 环境要求

- **DSH ≥ 0.1.0**（需含 Cordis 加载器，且宿主提供 `connection` / `webServer` 服务）
- **Node.js ≥ 20**
- 运行依赖由 npm 自动安装：`weixin-agent-sdk@^0.3.0`、`qrcode@^1.5.4`（peer：`@deepseek-ai/cordis >= 4.0.0`）

---

## 安装（推荐：作为 profile bundle）

1）在 profile 目录安装（`~/.dsh/profiles/<你的 profile>`）：

```bash
npm i github:liushQAQ/dsh-weixin-plus#v1.0.7
# 或使用 Release 附件：npm i ./dsh-weixin-plus-1.0.7.tgz
```

2）把包名加入 profile 的 bundle 列表（`package.json`）：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-weixin-plus": "github:liushQAQ/dsh-weixin-plus#v1.0.7" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-weixin-plus"] } }
}
```

插件自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch`），加载器据此挂载入口 `weixin-plus`。

3）重启 DSH（或触发加载器热重载），设置中心会出现「微信通道」。

> 进阶/开发：也可以像本机一样把仓库目录 `link:` 进 profile，再用内容哈希文件名（`p1.js → p2.js → …`）做免重启热挂载 —— 宿主按 **URL** 缓存 ESM 模块，原地改内容不会生效，必须换文件名。

## 可选配置

| 键 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `cwd` | agent 工作目录（缺省取已有工作区） |
| `provider` / `model` | 覆盖默认 provider 路由与模型 |
| `inboxDir` | 入站媒体归档目录（缺省 `<DSH_HOME>/weixin-inbox`） |

工作目录、模型、凭证位置全部走 DSH 运行时（`~/.dsh`）与上述配置，**不含任何机器专有路径**。

## 服务接口（宿主内）

| 通道 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| RPC | `/dsh-weixin-plus` | 客户端首选；`connection.rpc.call` |
| HTTP 回退 | `/dsh-weixin-plus-http/<action>` | POST/GET，action 如 `status`、`qrcode`、`login`、`logout`、`cancel-scan` |

---

## 变更记录

### v1.0.7 / filepush22（2026-10-20）

- **修复**：设置面板报「获取微信通道状态失败: HTTP 405」（同时 GET 返回 404）。两个根因都在插件侧：
  1. `connection.rpc.handle()` 内部会拿「读该服务的 ctx」去 `owner.effect(() => owner.webServer.register(route))`（官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection` 的 register 实现）。该 ctx 经 shadow 反解后落在父 ctx 上，其 `inject` 里没有 `webServer` ⇒ 抛 `cannot get property "webServer" without inject`，RPC 通道注册失败。
  2. RPC 通道与 HTTP 备用口注册了同一个 `{kind:'prefix', path:'/dsh-weixin-plus'}` ⇒ `webserver: duplicate prefix route`，实例一换路由即丢。
- **修法**：①HTTP 备用口改到独立路径 `/dsh-weixin-plus-http`；②RPC 通道改在 `apply` 体内直接注册，并用 `ctx.extend({ webServer: ctx.get('webServer') })` 把 `webServer` 绑成自有属性后再读 `.connection`（与官方 `dsh-mnemon` 同款写法）；③只注册带斜杠通道，重复注册幂等放过。
- **验证**：`POST/GET /dsh-weixin-plus/status` 由 405/404 → 401（路由已注册、匿名需认证）；`POST /dsh-weixin-plus-http/status` → 200 且返回真实状态（账号、`connected`、`isPollingOwner`）。

### v1.0.6

- 适配最新 DSH 内核，放宽 `peerDependencies`。

### v1.0.5 / filepush18

- 大图无损智能分流防 500（>2MB 走原图文件通道）。

---

## 架构

- `index.js`：宿主端逻辑 —— iLink 轮询、会话挂载、单实例选举、Cordis RPC 与 WebServer 路由。
- `client.js`：客户端 React 前端，挂载在 `settings.section`（id: `weixin`）。
- `cordis.patch.yml`：bundle 装配声明（入口 `weixin-plus`）。

plugins.description: Push DeepSeek Harness agent notifications to your phone and watch via ntfy, Bark, Gotify, Telegram or a webhook.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify-push
Push DeepSeek Harness agent notifications to your phone and watch via ntfy, Bark, Gotify, Telegram or a webhook — without keeping the browser tab open.
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-notify-push?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-notify-push?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/releases/tag/v0.4.1)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-notify-push?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-notify-push?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh)
plugin. It pushes a short notification to your **phone** — and, through the
phone's own notification mirroring, to your **watch** — whenever an agent
finishes a turn, hits an error, or is waiting on your approval.

Unlike a browser notification, this leaves the machine: it goes out over the
network to a push service you choose, so it arrives while the Harness tab is
closed and the laptop lid is shut.

```
Settings ▸ Notify Push                          v0.4.1
└── delivery state, an editable configuration form,
    the exact server and topic to subscribe to, armed triggers,
    a live preview, the delivery log,
    and one "Send test notification" button
```

It is a section of the Settings panel, not a page in the working area: a
notifier is configured once and glanced at occasionally, so giving it a permanent
sidebar icon and a whole centre column overstated it. The Settings shell owns the
trigger, the nav entry, the panel and the scrolling container, so this plugin
contributes only the section body — deliberately with no `height`, no second
scroll and no horizontal padding, all of which the shell already provides.

The version beside the title is read from the manifest **at runtime**, not baked
in at build time, so it names the build the harness actually loaded. That matters
because installing a new package does not re-compose a running profile: a swap on
disk leaves the old code live until a restart, and the chip is the fastest way to
tell those two situations apart.

## What a notification says

Every notification carries the same three facts, in a fixed shape:

| Part | Where | Example |
|---|---|---|
| **event type** | title | `Agent finished` |
| **host** | title | `workstation.local` |
| **session** | body line 1 | `Fix the login redirect` |
| **detail** | body line 2 | `done in 42s` |

So a lock screen reads:

```
Agent finished · workstation.local
Fix the login redirect
done in 42s
```

The event type is one of `Agent finished`, `Agent error`, `Approval needed`,
`Question asked` or `Test notification`. `titlePrefix` prepends a literal
(`DSH · …`) when you run more than one Harness.

A `Question asked` notification carries the question itself, not just word that
one exists — a prompt that only said "the agent has a question" would make you
open the app to find out whether it mattered:

```
Question asked · workstation.local
Fix the login redirect
Choose Mode — Which deployment should I target?
Blue · Green
```

The heading, the question and (when there are a few) the offered choices, so the
lock screen carries enough to decide whether to answer now. A longer question is
truncated here, with a visible ellipsis, rather than left for the OS to cut
mid-word.

## Screenshots

![Notification pipeline](docs/images/notification-flow.png)
*How an event reaches your phone: the engine paces and de-duplicates, the formatter composes the two lines, the provider delivers.*

![Notification preview](docs/images/notification-preview.png)
*Rendered from this plugin's own formatter output — the exact title and body strings, shown as they appear on a lock screen. Not a device screenshot.*

![Settings section layout](docs/images/settings-section-mockup.png)
*Layout mockup of the **Settings ▸ Notify Push** section (illustrative, not a screenshot).*

## Surfaces

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| Host route `GET /api/dsh-notify-push/status` | provider, destination, armed triggers, counters, live preview, form descriptors |
| Host route `GET /api/dsh-notify-push/history` | the recent delivery log |
| Host route `POST /api/dsh-notify-push/test` | send one synthetic notification |
| Host route `POST /api/dsh-notify-push/config` | merge validated settings into this row's config |
| Settings section **Notify Push** | the whole surface: status, form, subscribe block, preview, log and test button |

One slot registration, into `settings.section` — a `list` slot declared by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-general`, whose entries carry
`{ id, order, label }` and whose active entry the shell renders inside its own
scrolling panel. `dsh.client.inject` names both that package and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings`, which owns the canonical slot contract and
is what makes the registration type-check against the real slot map.

Every route is loopback-fenced, method-checked and body-size-capped. The config
route additionally validates its patch against the field specs before anything is
written — a rejected key never reaches the settings document, which outlives the
process and would otherwise be reapplied on every boot.

## Install

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check                              # typecheck both halves, build, then vitest
pnpm run pack                           # -> dist/dsh-notify-push-0.4.1.tgz
```

The desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so `dsh plugin add`
refuses it: install the packed tarball from **Settings → Plugins**. A bundle
added to a running profile needs a **restart** before its entry can be imported;
the browser half additionally needs the page reloaded.

## Configure

**Edit it in the panel.** Open **Settings → Notify Push**; the **Configuration**
section renders a form for the selected provider: pick the backend, fill in its
fields, press Save. A saved value applies **immediately** — no restart — because
every field of the row's schema is `volatile`, so the loader swaps it into the
running fiber rather than waiting for the next boot. It is also written to the
host's settings document, so it comes back after a restart.

Secret fields (tokens, device keys) are **write-only**: the stored value never
leaves the host, so the input starts blank and shows `stored` or `not set`.
Leaving it blank keeps what is there — there is no clear action, deliberately, so
a save can never wipe a working credential by accident.

Each secret field carries its own eye button, which unmasks **what you are
typing** so you can check a paste before saving. It cannot show the stored value,
because the browser was never given it — an untouched field stays empty with its
`stored` placeholder, revealed or not.

Configuration also works from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, which survives
plugin upgrades. The row id is `dsh-notify-push`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-notify-push
  name: dsh-notify-push
  config:
    provider: ntfy
    ntfyServer: https://ntfy.sh
    ntfyTopic: <a long random topic>
```

Both paths write the same thing, so you can set a value in YAML and later adjust
it in the panel, or the reverse. If a deployment composes no settings service the
form renders read-only and says so, rather than accepting a change with nowhere
to put it.

**Installing changes nothing on its own.** Every trigger defaults to on, but no
provider is c

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-playwright

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/akash-digitavision/dsh-playwright)

**One-line value:** install this and every DeepSeek Harness agent can drive a real browser — navigation, clicking, typing, snapshots, screenshots — using the official Microsoft Playwright MCP.

DeepSeek Harness profile bundle installing the **official Microsoft Playwright MCP** (`@playwright/mcp`) — browser automation through structured **accessibility snapshots** (no vision model needed), from [github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp). Same bundle pattern as `dsh-chrome-devtools`.

**Capability category:** 工具与能力 (Tools & Capabilities)
**License:** MIT · **Compatibility:** DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 (bundles API), Windows/macOS/Linux (Node.js + npx + Chrome/Chromium required)

Configuration source: verified via Context7 against the project's own README — the standard client config is exactly:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "playwright": { "command": "npx", "args": ["@playwright/mcp@latest"] } } }
```

## What it adds to every agent on the profile

| Row | Module | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `mcp-playwright` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` | Spawns `npx @playwright/mcp@latest` (stdio) → tools namespaced `mcp__playwright__*`: `browser_navigate`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_click`, `browser_type`, `browser_take_screenshot`, tabs, requests, and more |

- Uses your **installed Google Chrome** by default (headed, persistent profile)
- First start downloads the package via npx (30–60s); afterwards it starts in ~1s
- Coexists with `dsh-chrome-devtools` — separate tool namespace and browser instance

## Install

**One command (recommended):**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:akash-digitavision/dsh-playwright
```

or in **Settings → Plugin Market** (DSH Plugin Hub), search for `dsh-playwright`.

**Manual alternative** — add `dsh-playwright` to the profile `package.json` `dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles`, run `pnpm install` in the profile, restart or re-apply.

**Requirements:** Node.js ≥ 18 with npx (the MCP server downloads on first use), and an installed Chrome or Chromium.

> Note: `file:` dependencies are **copied** into the profile by pnpm — after editing this bundle's `cordis.patch.yml`, run `pnpm install` again (or edit the installed copy under `node_modules\dsh-playwright`) before re-applying.

## Permissions & external services

- Spawns a local `npx @playwright/mcp` process that launches a real browser on your machine
- No accounts, no API keys, no telemetry; network access is whatever pages you browse
- Edits/automation run with your user privileges — review prompts before approving destructive actions

## Optional launch flags

Append to `args` in `cordis.patch.yml`:

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--isolated` | In-memory profile; no persisted cookies/storage |
| `--headless` | No visible browser window |
| `--browser chromium` | Playwright's bundled Chromium instead of system Chrome |
| `--caps=vision,pdf` | Extra capability tools |
| `--config <file.json>` | Full JSON configuration (browser, timeouts, network rules, secrets — see project docs) |

## Verify

Ask the agent to `browser_navigate` to any page and `browser_snapshot` it — or check the plugin list for the live `include:mcp-playwright` entry.

## Publish / uninstall

Push this folder to GitHub and install `"dsh-playwright": "github:<you>/dsh-playwright"`. Remove from `bundles` + `dependencies` to uninstall; the npx cache can be kept or cleared separately.

plugins.description: Token usage statistics dashboard plugin for DeepSeek Harness: stat cards, 53-week activity heatmap, per-model trend and model share
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-usage-dashboard

DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量统计插件 —— 在 **设置 → Token 统计** 中提供 zcode 风格的用量面板：

- **5 张指标卡**：累计 Token、单日峰值、最长会话时长、当前/最长连续使用天数
- **Token 活动热力图**：53 周 GitHub 风格（每日 / 累计切换）
- **每日 Token 趋势**：近 7 日 / 近 30 日，按模型分系列折线
- **模型用量环形图**：占比 + 明细列表

## 原理

- **零运行时依赖**，图表全部手写 SVG。
- 服务端注册 `tokenStats` 会话投影（`ctx.sessionProjections.register`），
  折叠 `request/header` / `step/start` / `assistant usage` / `step/end` /
  `compaction/summary` 事件，按 **天 × 模型** 累计 token。Harness 会在会话
  首次被触碰时回放持久化日志，因此历史会话同样被统计。
- 客户端通过 `settings.section` 槽位注入设置页，聚合全部会话的
  `projectionValues.tokenStats` 渲染面板。

## 安装

### npm（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-usage-dashboard
# 桌面版：设置 → 插件 → Add plugin → npm 包名填 dsh-usage-dashboard
```

### 从源码 / 本地开发

```bash
# web / tui profile：
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-usage-dashboard

# desktop profile 暂无插件页安装入口，需手动：
# 1. 依赖 + bundle 声明（ ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json ）
#    dependencies 增加 "dsh-usage-dashboard": "file:/path/to/dsh-usage-dashboard"
#    dsh.profile.bundles 增加 "dsh-usage-dashboard"
# 2. 安装
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && npx pnpm@11.9.0 install
# 3. 重启 DeepSeek Harness 应用
```

### 从 GitHub

```bash
dsh plugin add github:<owner>/dsh-usage-dashboard
```

（git 安装装的是源码，可能需要在 profile 的 pnpm-workspace 里授权构建脚本；
优先推荐 npm 安装。）

## 历史数据回填

投影按需折叠：只有被打开过的会话才有数据。要一次性回填全部历史，运行：

```bash
node tools/backfill.mjs --dry   # 预览
node tools/backfill.mjs         # 写入 projcache（自动跳过活跃会话）
```

回填后重启 Harness，设置面板立即显示全部历史统计。

## 口径说明

- token 总量 = input + cacheRead + cacheWrite + output（与内置 tokenUsage 投影一致，
  已对 19 个真实会话逐一对账验证）。
- 同一 (turn, step) 的多次 usage 上报只计最新一次（流式 chunk 替换语义）。
- 不估算费用，只统计 token。

## 开发

```bash
npm run check   # 语法检查
npm test        # 投影 fold 单元测试（node:test，无外部依赖）
```

## 兼容性

peer 依赖接受 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` 起的 0.1 线与 0.2 线全部版本（含 rc）。
0.3.0 及以后未经测试。

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek Harness 和 WorkBuddy 连起来：记忆/技能同步 + 无界面遥控 + 界面驱动（CDP）+ 对话面板，四合一插件。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-wb —— 让 DeepSeek Harness 和 WorkBuddy 互相认识

![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/YE-ZINAN/dsh-wb?label=release&color=00d4ff)
![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/YE-ZINAN/dsh-wb?color=8b5cf6)
![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows-0078d4)

一句话：装了它，你在 dsh 里就能**看到 WorkBuddy 记了什么、让它干活、跟它对话，甚至直接用 dsh 操作 WorkBuddy 的界面**。

---

## 这是干什么的

WorkBuddy 和 dsh 本来是两套各干各的 AI 工具：各聊各的、各记各的。这个插件把它们连起来 —— 装**一个**插件，多出**四样能力**：

| 你能做的事 | 说白了就是 |
|---|---|
| 📚 **看它记住了什么** | 把 WorkBuddy 的记忆、技能、计划列出来、搜出来、读出来 |
| 🛠️ **让它干活** | 把任务丢给 WorkBuddy 本机的执行引擎，跑完把结果拿回来 |
| 💬 **在 dsh 里跟它聊** | dsh 里多一个「WB 对话」面板，不用来回切窗口 |
| 🖱️ **直接操作它的界面** | 打开它的历史对话、替它发消息 —— **对话留在 WorkBuddy 里**，用它自己的账号额度 |

最后一条是重点：不是"另起一个进程偷偷跑"，而是**真的在 WorkBuddy 界面里操作**。所以你在旁边看着，能看见字一个个打进去。

![在 WorkBuddy 里跑的对话](docs/shots/wb-app.png)

上图是 **WorkBuddy 那边**的样子 —— 对话真的长在它的界面里。

下图是 **dsh 这边**的面板：左边选会话、中间看内容、上面切模型（带积分倍率）。

![dsh 里的 WB 对话面板](docs/shots/dsh-panel.png)

---

## 你需要什么

- **Windows**（目前按 Windows 实现）
- 装好 **dsh 桌面版**
- 装好 **WorkBuddy 桌面版**
- 会点图标就行

---

## 安装

三种方式，挑一种：

**① 一条地址装（推荐，最省事，不需要任何账号）**

在 dsh 的插件管理里「从地址安装」，粘这个：

```
https://github.com/YE-ZINAN/dsh-wb/releases/download/v1.0.0/dsh-wb-1.0.0.tgz
```

（它就是个 npm 包，dsh 会自动下载依赖装好。）

**② 从 GitHub 仓库直接装**

```
github:YE-ZINAN/dsh-wb
```

**③ 本地文件夹**

把仓库下载下来，在插件管理里选那个文件夹。

> **npm**：包名 `dsh-wb` 已确认可用，但本机还没登录 npm（`npm login` 只能你本人做）。
> 你登录后任一时刻执行 `npm publish` 就能发上去 —— 之后大家用 `dsh-wb` 这个包名装即可。

装完 **刷新一次 dsh 页面**（F5），左栏会多一个 WB 图标。

---

## 第一次用

1. 点左栏的 **WB 图标**，打开对话面板
2. 顶上「传输方式」保持 **WB 界面**（这样对话才出现在 WorkBuddy 里）
3. 「会话」下拉选一段历史 → 它会**在 WorkBuddy 里真的切过去**，面板同步显示那段历史
4. 下面输入框打字，回车

> 只想让它后台跑、不碰界面？把「传输方式」切成 **无界面**。

---

## 工作原理（一眼看懂）

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph DSH["dsh · 你的控制台"]
    P["WB 对话面板"]
    T["25 个工具"]
  end
  subgraph WB["WorkBuddy · 真正干活的那个"]
    UI["界面"]
    E["执行引擎"]
    M["记忆 / 技能"]
  end
  P -- 1 --> UI
  T -- 2 --> UI
  T -- 3 --> E
  T -- 4 --> M
```

① HTTP 路由：面板通过宿主的路由直接读写界面内容
② CDP 调试端口：工具在**真实界面**里点击、输入、发送
③ headless 进程：另起一个命令行进程干活（界面里看不到，但最稳）
④ 直接读写文件：同步记忆与技能清单

四块各走各的路，互不影响：

| 模块 | 走哪条路 | 什么时候用它 |
|---|---|---|
| `sync` | 直接读写文件 | 想把两边的记忆和技能清单对齐 |
| `bridge` | 另起一个命令行进程 | 让它稳稳干活（界面里看不到，但最快最省事） |
| `gui` | CDP 调试端口 | 操作真实界面、想看着它干 |
| `chat` | 上面几个的合体 | 就是那个对话面板 |

---

## 安全提醒（请读一遍）

- **调试端口开着的时候，本机上任何程序都能完全控制 WorkBuddy**（读你所有会话、替你发消息）。
  端口只绑 `127.0.0.1`，**手机和局域网进不来**，但本机程序没有门槛。
- 不想长期开着：关掉 WorkBuddy，或下次**不带参数**启动，端口就没了。
- 这个插件**不读你的 API key**。它用的是 WorkBuddy 自己的账号额度；就算你在引擎配置里放了私有 key，本插件也从不读取、不转发。
- 界面模式抓的是界面上的文字，只在你本机流转，不会上传到任何地方。

## 它不会动你的东西

- **不删、不改**你的 WorkBuddy 数据；
- 同步只往你指定的日志文件里**追加**，写前自动备份（`.bak-dshsync`），每次写了什么都有台账可查；
- 身份类信息**永不自动写入**，要你自己确认。

---

## 遇到问题

**面板显示「CDP 未连」**
WorkBuddy 是普通方式启动的，没开调试端口。两个办法：
1. 点面板上的「**启动/重连 WB**」—— 它会关掉并重启 WorkBuddy 并带上端口。会话不会丢（都落盘了）。
2. 一劳永逸：把开始菜单里 WorkBuddy 快捷方式的启动参数改成
   `--remote-debugging-port=9223 --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows --disable-renderer-backgrounding --disable-background-timer-throttling --disable-features=CalculateNativeWinOcclusion`
   以后每次启动都自带端口，最小化时界面也不卡。

**WorkBuddy 最小化时界面好像不动**
Chromium 对最小化窗口会停止重绘 —— 上面那串参数里的后半段就是解决它的。

**对话串到别的会话里了**
早期版本有这个 bug（已修）。如果还遇到，把当时的操作顺序告诉作者。

---

## 想深入了解

- [技术总览](docs/architecture.md)：结构、配置、回滚
- 四个模块的实测细节（含踩过的坑）：[sync](docs/sync.md) · [bridge](docs/bridge.md) · [chat](docs/chat.md) · [gui](docs/gui.md)

## 规模

25 个工具 / 15 条 HTTP 路由 / 1 个对话面板 —— 四个模块合成一个插件。所有测试加起来 **210 项断言**，全绿。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Unofficial React components in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI design system: the DSH primitives plus the components DSH lacks (cards, tabs, pagination, messages, upload, date/time pickers), on the same --dsw-* tokens.
plugins.readme_text:
# @seekbuddy/dsh-ui English | [中文](README.zh.md) React components in the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) web UI design system, for building product pages around DSH: the DSH primitives (`--dsw-*` design tokens, light / dark themes, controls, icons, Markdown and tool-output renderers) plus the components DSH does not provide, such as cards, tabs, pagination, messages, upload and date / time pickers, built on the same tokens. Packaged for ordinary React 18 / 19 and Next.js apps. **Live preview:** every component in [Storybook](https://seekbuddy.github.io/dsh-ui/). > **Unofficial.** This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by DeepSeek. It ships no DeepSeek brand assets (logo or wordmark). See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). ## Why this package The DSH UI primitives (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`) cover what the DSH web shell needs: chat, tool output, menus, dialogs. A product built around DSH also has consoles, settings and admin pages, and those need components DSH does not have: cards, tabs, pagination, date and time input, upload, global messages. Writing them separately in each app drifts away from the DSH look; patching them into a copy of the primitives turns every upstream sync into a merge. This package provides those components and keeps them apart from DSH: - **Extension components** (`@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/seekbuddy`) fill the gaps. They are styled only with the DSH tokens and follow DSH's styling rules, so they sit next to DSH controls without looking different, and they reuse DSH controls through the public entry instead of re-implementing them. See [docs/components](docs/components/README.md). - **The DSH layer** is a copy of the upstream primitives with packaging fixes only, each recorded in [UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md), so it follows upstream tags. To make the DSH layer usable in an ordinary app, it also fixes three packaging problems of the official package: | Official package | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui` | | --- | --- | | One root entry re-exports everything, so Shiki and KaTeX land in the first page load | Split entries; the root entry is guarded at build time against reaching Markdown, Shiki, KaTeX or the code-file artwork | | Theme tokens and theme switching live in a Cordis plugin | `tokens.css` and a standalone `light / dark / system` theme runtime with a no-flash bootstrap script | | KaTeX output is converted with the browser-only `DOMParser` | SSR-safe KaTeX rendering; tested with React 18 SSR and a Next.js 16 build | ## Install ```sh npm install @seekbuddy/dsh-ui ``` Peer dependencies: `react` and `react-dom` `^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0`. ## Quick start Import the global token sheet once, in your app entry. Import `katex.css` only if you render math. ```tsx import '@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/tokens.css' import '@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/katex.css' import { Button, Pill } from '@seekbuddy/dsh-ui' import { MarkdownText } from '@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/markdown' import { IconCheckOutlineRegular } from '@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/icons' import { setThemePreference } from '@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/theme' const labels = { code: { copyLabel: 'Copy', copiedLabel: 'Copied' }, footnotes: 'Footnotes', } export function Example() { return (
Enabled
) } ``` Component styles are CSS Modules compiled into the JavaScript and injected into `` once, the first time a component module loads. `tokens.css` and `katex.css` are the only global stylesheets. Components contain no user-facing text: every visible or screen-reader label is a prop (usually a typed `labels` object), so you localize them in your app. ## Entry points Import only from these entries; anything else under `dist/` is internal. | Entry | Contents | | --- | --- | | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui` | Lightweight controls and utilities: `Button`, `Input`, `Pill`, `Tag`, `Switch`, `Checkbox`, `Menu`, `MenuSurface`, `Modal`, `Tooltip`, `Toast`, `HoverCard`, `SegmentedControl`, `SegmentedTabs`, positioning / modal hooks, and helpers such as `relativeTime`, `fileSizeText`, `rankByName` | | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/blocks` | Tool-output renderers `TerminalBlock`, `ReadBlock`, `DiffBlock`, `SearchBlock`, `WebBlock`, `JsonTree`; file / link icons `FileTypeIcon`, `LinkIconRegular` / `LinkIconMedium`; code highlighting `languageForPath`, `useCodeHighlighter` (loads Shiki) | | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/markdown` | `MarkdownText`, `CodeBlock`, `JsonBlock`, `MarkdownDelegateProvider`, `extractMarkdownPlainText` | | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/icons` | 188 `Icon*` components (94 glyphs × `Regular` / `Medium` stroke), `PermissionIcon*`, `ReferenceIcon*`, `PluginArtwork*`, `GuideArtwork*` | | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/theme` | Theme state, DOM application and React hooks | | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/theme/bootstrap` | `THEME_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPT`, an inline script with no React dependency | | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/seekbuddy` | Extra components ([docs](docs/components/README.md)); the whole entry is a Client Component | | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/seekbuddy/{card,empty,spinner,timeline}` | Hook-free extra components that a Next.js Server Component may import | | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/seekbuddy/tabs` | `Tabs`; same as importing it from `/seekbuddy` | | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/tokens.css` | The eight DSH theme sheets, concatenated in their cascade order | | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/katex.css` | KaTeX CSS reduced to woff2 fonts | ## Two layers | Layer | Source | Contents | | --- | --- | --- | | DSH layer | `src/` except `src/seekbuddy/` | A copy of the DSH web UI primitives and theme sheets, kept in sync with upstream tags. Local changes are listed in [UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md); everything else is unchanged upstream code. | | Extra components | `src/seekbuddy/` | Components DSH does not provide, written for this package and styled only with `--dsw-*` tokens | Extra components: `Card`, `Empty`, `Mark`, `MessageProvider` + `useMessage`, `Pagination` (+ `pageItems`), `QrCode`, `Spinner`, `StatusBadge`, `Switch`, `Tabs`, `Timeline`, `Upload`, `DangerButton`, `SubtleButton`, and the date / time family `Calendar`, `DatePicker`, `DateRangePicker`, `TimePicker`, `DateField`, `DateRangeField`, `TimeField`. **Each one is documented — usage, examples and the full API — in [docs/components](docs/components/README.md).** The extra components import DSH components through the public `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui` entry, never by relative path. A bundler can therefore alias that entry to another copy of the DSH primitives (for example the one a DSH web shell already loads), and the page keeps a single implementation of each control. Importing one component from `/seekbuddy` does not pull in the others: every component is built into its own chunk, together with its CSS. ## Theme The theme preference is `light | dark | system`. It is stored in `localStorage` under `dsh-ui-primitives.theme-preference` (the key keeps the package's former name for compatibility). ```tsx import { initializeTheme, setThemePreference, useIsDark, useThemePreference } from '@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/theme' initializeTheme() ``` `initializeTheme()` restores a valid stored value and falls back to `system`; it still applies the theme when `localStorage` is unavailable. The theme is applied through `document.documentElement.style.colorScheme` and the `data-ds-dark-theme` attribute on `body`. For server-rendered apps, run the bootstrap script before the page content, so a stored dark preference does not flash light on first load. plugins.description: Browser-side attention reminders for DeepSeek Harness — desktop notification, tab-title dot and PWA badge when a reply finishes in the background or a session needs your input. 会话在后台跑完或等你回应时：系统通知 + 标题红点 + PWA 徽标。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-attention

English | [中文说明](#中文说明)

Attention reminders for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) —
a **client-only** plugin. No DSH core file is patched.

When a session needs you, three signals light up together:

| Signal | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| Desktop notification | A real system notification — title `回复已完成` / `Reply finished`, body names the session |
| Tab-title dot | `● ` prefixed to the browser tab title |
| PWA taskbar badge | `navigator.setAppBadge(n)` — the app-icon badge of an installed PWA |

It fires at exactly two moments, and **only while the window is in the background**
(`document.hidden || !document.hasFocus()`), so it never interrupts you while you are
already looking at the app:

1. **A reply finished** — a session's `running` goes `true → false`.
2. **A session is waiting for you** — a session's `pendingInteraction` appears:
   `approval`, `plan-review` or `question`.

All three signals clear the moment you return to the window. Subagent sessions are
skipped on purpose: they are not yours to answer.

## Install

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:renjianbuchai/dsh-session-attention
```

`dsh plugin` is a thin wrapper around pnpm, so any pnpm spec works — `<dir>` for a
local checkout, `github:<user>/<repo>`, or the npm name once published. The command
writes the dependency **and** enables the plugin in the profile; there is nothing
else to toggle.

Once the plugin is listed in the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)
catalog, it can also be installed from the DSH plugin market with one click.

Two things that will otherwise waste your time:

- If pnpm refuses with `ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION`, add
  `--config.minimumReleaseAge=0`. That is a pnpm release-age policy knob and has
  nothing to do with this plugin — a branch or publish can simply be too recent for
  the configured window.
- **Grant the notification permission when the browser asks.** Without it the tab dot
  and the badge still work, but the desktop notification stays silent by design
  (nothing is prompted from a background event, because a browser ignores a
  permission request that has no user gesture behind it).

## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.1-alpha.1 < 0.3.0-0` (developed and verified on `0.2.1-alpha.1`)
- Node `>= 22.19.0` — DSH itself requires `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- A web profile in a browser. The desktop notification needs `Notification`; the
  taskbar badge needs `navigator.setAppBadge` (installed PWA, Chromium-based). Both
  are presence-guarded: where the API is missing, that one signal no-ops and the
  others keep working.

## How it works

- The client half subscribes to two public host observables — `uiSession.sessionStatus`
  and `sessions.list` — and derives the two edges above. Nothing else is read, and no
  DSH source file is modified.
- The title dot is maintained by a `MutationObserver` on `<title>`. The shell owns
  `document.title` and rewrites it on every navigation, so the plugin never takes
  ownership — it only re-adds the mark while events are unseen, and removes it when
  the count returns to zero.
- Notifications are de-duplicated by a stable per-session tag (`done:<id>` /
  `pending:<id>`). The previous notification carrying that tag is explicitly closed
  and `renotify: true` is set, so a repeat event re-alerts instead of being silently
  replaced; live `Notification` objects are retained until they close.
- Every notification title carries a `DSH · ` brand prefix and the icon the page
  itself declares. The app name shown *above* a toast is chosen by the browser
  (Chrome uses its own App User Model Id), so a page cannot set it — the prefix is
  the plugin's only way to make the toast unmistakably DSH.
- The host half (`lib/index.js`) declares the plugin and does nothing else: it writes
  no files and opens no sockets.

## Debug surface

With the plugin loaded, the browser console exposes:

```js
__DSH_ATTENTION__.permission  // current Notification permission
__DSH_ATTENTION__.log         // recent decisions: notified / skipped / failed + reason
__DSH_ATTENTION__.test()      // fire one notification through the plugin's own path
```

`test()` is the quickest way to separate "the browser or the OS is blocking toasts"
from "the plugin never fired" — it uses the same code path as a real event.

## Verification

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm typecheck` | host + client halves, both `--noEmit` — 0 errors |
| `pnpm selftest` | **45 / 45** assertions against the built `lib/client.js`, run both on the local artifact and on the exact bytes the DSH web server serves |
| `pnpm e2e` | **17 / 17** against a real Chromium, a real running DSH instance and a real model turn: notification title/body/tag, `●` in the title, `setAppBadge(1)`, dot removal and `clearAppBadge()` on return, and that the document was not reloaded mid-wait (a reload would silently drop the test's background simulation and look like a plugin bug) |

Limits, stated plainly:

- The desktop toast is painted by the browser and the OS. A headless browser cannot
  assert that, so `e2e` verifies that the notification is **constructed with the right
  arguments** — not that Windows drew it.
- Background state in `e2e` is a controlled `document.hidden` / `hasFocus()`
  simulation, because headless Chromium has no real tab focus.
- Windows Focus Assist (Do Not Disturb) and the per-app notification switch can
  suppress toasts independently of any plugin. If `__DSH_ATTENTION__.test()` produces
  no toast while `__DSH_ATTENTION__.log` says `notified`, the block is on that side.

## Provenance

The behavior is ported from DSH 0.1.x's built-in completion attention
(`packages/client/ui-renderer/src/client/completion-attention.ts` and
`use-completion-attention.ts`, commits `29d556d7b2`, `3cb88b4aa5`, `3e0553ed90`) and
rebuilt as an installable plugin that uses only public platform APIs — the same
behavior on 0.2.x, without patching the renderer.

## Development

```sh
DSH_HOME=<dsh home> DSH_CHECKOUT=<deepseek-harness checkout> pnpm prepare:links
pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm selftest
```

`prepare:links` mirrors the `@deepseek-ai/*` packages out of the profile's
`node_modules` (and the checkout's `vendor/`, where `cordis` and friends live) into
this project so `tsc` can see the host types. Those packages are pre-release and are
not reliably available from the public registry; at runtime the profile resolves them,
so the links only serve type-checking. Both paths come from environment variables —
the script intentionally hard-codes no machine-specific path.

`pnpm e2e` needs a running DSH web instance and takes its target from environment
variables (`DSH_URL`, `DSH_WORKSPACE`, `DSH_TASK`, `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`).

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

---

## 中文说明

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的**后台提醒**
插件，纯客户端，**不修改 DSH 核心任何文件**。

会话需要你时，三处同时亮起：

| 信号 | 具体是什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 系统通知 | 真正的桌面通知 —— 标题带 `DSH · ` 品牌前缀（如 `DSH · 回复已完成`；英文环境为 `DSH · Reply completed`），正文写出会话名，图标取页面自己声明的那个（气泡**上方**那行应用名由浏览器决定，网页改不了，所以用标题前缀来表明身份） |
| 标题页红点 | 浏览器标签标题前加 `● ` |
| PWA 任务栏徽标 | `navigator.setAppBadge(n)` —— 已安装 PWA 的应用图标角标 |

只在**两个时刻**触发，且**只在你不在窗口时**（`document.hidden || !document.hasFocus()`）——
你正看着它的时候不会打扰你：

1. **回复完成** —— 某个会话的 `running` 由 `true` 变 `false`。
2. **会话在等你** —— 某个会话出现 `pendingInteraction`：审批、计划审阅或提问。

回到窗口时三处信号立刻清除。**子代理会话按设计跳过** —— 它们不该由你回答。

### 安装

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:renjianbuchai/dsh-session-attention
```

`dsh plugin` 是 pnpm 的薄封装，因此任何 pnpm 写法都可用 —— 本地目录 `<dir>`、
`github:<用户>/<仓库>`、或将来发布后的 npm 包名。这条命令会同时写入依赖**并**在
profile 里启用插件，没有别的开关要动。

等本插件进入 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) 精选目录后，
也可以直接在 DSH 插件市场里一键安装。

两个会浪费时间的地方，先说清：

- 若 pnpm 报 `ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION`，加上
  `--config.minimumReleaseAge=0`。那是 pnpm 的「发布冷却期」策略，与本插件无关 ——
  新分支或新发布可能刚好落在冷却窗口内。
- **浏览器询问通知权限时请允许。** 没授权时标题红点与徽标照常工作，但桌面通知
  会按设计保持静默（后台事件里不会去申请权限：浏览器会忽略没有用户手势的权限请求）。

### 环境要求

- DSH `>= 0.2.1-alpha.1 < 0.3.0-0`（在 `0.2.1-alpha.1` 上开发与验证）
- Node `>= 22.19.0` —— DSH 自身要求 `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`

plugins.description: 使用agens免费api key生成图片
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agnes-image

**给 DeepSeek Harness 装一个会画图的大脑：说一句话，出图。**
文生图 / 图生图 / 多图合成，基于 **Agnes AI**（`agnes-image-2.5-flash`）。零依赖，纯 JavaScript，无需构建。

**Image generation for DeepSeek Harness** — text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image
composition via **Agnes AI**. Zero dependencies, no build step.

关键词 / Keywords：`dsh` `dsh-plugin` `deepseek-harness` `生图` `文生图` `图生图` `图片生成` `图片编辑` `Agnes` `agnes-image-2.5-flash` `image-generation` `text-to-image` `image-to-image`

![一只正在画布前作画的鹈鹕，由本插件调用 agnes-image-2.5-flash 生成（1K / 16:9）](docs/preview.jpg)

> 非官方社区插件，与 DeepSeek、Agnes AI 均无隶属关系。MIT 许可，无担保。
> Unofficial community plugin, not affiliated with DeepSeek or Agnes AI. MIT, no warranty.

---

## 30 秒看懂

| 你想干什么 | 你就这么说（不用记命令） |
|---|---|
| 凭空画一张 | 「画一张夕阳下的海，电影感，16:9」 |
| 改一张现有的图 | 「把 `D:\shots\cat.png` 改成赛博朋克夜景，保留构图」 |
| 用好几张图合成一张 | 「用这两张做海报：第一张是角色，第二张是产品」 |

模型会自动调用本插件的工具 `agnes_generate_image`，把图存到你的工作目录，并**直接显示在对话里**。

```
你的项目\
└── generated-images\
    └── 2026-10-10\                      ← 按日期分文件夹，不会堆成一坨
        ├── a-cheerful-pelican-120933.png
        └── a-cheerful-pelican-120945.png   ← 一秒内连画两张也不会互相覆盖
```

---

## 这是什么？（完全没接触过也能看懂）

三个名词，一句话一个：

| 名词 | 说人话 |
|---|---|
| **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** | 你正在用的这个 AI 助手客户端。它有「手」——能读写文件、跑命令——但**出厂时不带画图能力** |
| **插件（plugin）** | 给 DSH 装的一个小零件，装完它就多一项本事。本插件加的是一把「画笔」 |
| **Agnes AI** | 一家提供 AI 画图接口的服务商（类似「云端画师」）。你把描述发给它，它把图发回来。图像模型目前免费 |

流程就是这样：

```
你说话  →  DSH 里的模型理解意图  →  调用本插件的工具
        →  插件把描述发给 Agnes  →  拿回图片  →  存到本地 + 显示在对话里
```

**它能做什么**：文生图、图生图（改风格/换背景/局部改）、多图合成。
**它不能做什么**：视频、图库管理、批量队列、在线编辑器。

---

## 手把手安装（照着做，10 分钟）

### 准备清单

- [ ] 一个能正常对话的 DeepSeek Harness（桌面版或命令行版都行）
- [ ] 一个 Agnes AI 账号（注册免费）
- [ ] 大约 10 分钟

---

### 第 1 步：确认 Harness 能用

先随便跟它说句话，能正常回复就跳过这一步。

**没有 Harness？**

- 桌面版：去 [deepseek.com/harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/) 下载安装包（Windows / macOS），自带运行环境，不用预装任何东西
- 命令行版：先装 [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/)（要求 `^22.19.0` 或 `>= 24`），然后在终端跑 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`

> 两个版本可以共存、共用会话记录，但**插件要各自安装一次**。

---

### 第 2 步：申请 Agnes API Key（就是一把钥匙）

1. 打开 [agnes-ai.com](https://agnes-ai.com)，注册 / 登录
2. 进入**开发者控制台**
3. 找到 **API Key 管理**，点「创建」
4. 复制那串 **`sk-` 开头的长字符串**

⚠️ **两个最常见的新手错误**：

- ❌ 复制的是你给 Key 起的**名字**（比如 `my-image-key`）→ ✅ 要的是创建时那串 `sk-...` 的**值**
- ❌ 关掉弹窗才想起来没复制 → ✅ 大多数平台只显示一次，看不到就**重新创建一个**

把它先粘贴到记事本里，第 4 步要用。

---

### 第 3 步：安装插件

#### 方式 A：命令行（推荐，最不容易踩坑）

打开终端（Windows 用 PowerShell），执行**其中一条**：

```sh
# 从 GitHub 装（本项目发布后）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Naskete/dsh-agnes-image

# 从本地目录装（自己 clone 下来或者别人给你的文件夹）
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\path\to\dsh-agnes-image

# 从压缩包装（Release 里下载的 .tgz）
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\path\to\dsh-agnes-image-0.1.0.tgz
```

`--profile` 后面填哪个？桌面版通常是 `desktop`，命令行版通常是 `web`。不确定就跑这条看：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web list
```

✅ **成功的标志**：命令跑完没有报错，`list` 里能看到 `dsh-agnes-image`。

#### 方式 B：图形界面

1. 打开 Harness → 左侧边栏 **「插件」**
2. 右上角 **「+ 添加插件」**
3. 输入框里填 `dsh-agnes-image`（npm 包名），或本地文件夹的**绝对路径**
4. 点「安装」，等进度跑完

> 界面在安装前会先联网查一次包信息，这一步**只认 npm 上的包**。
> 填 `github:...` 地址会卡在这里 —— 那种情况请走方式 A。

#### 装完还想卸载？

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-agnes-image
```

---

### 第 4 步：把 Key 填进去（三选一）

**方式 ①：写进密钥文件（最推荐 —— 不用重启、不会误传上网）**

新建文件（Windows：`C:\Users\<你的用户名>\.dsh\agnes-image.config.json`，macOS / Linux：`~/.dsh/agnes-image.config.json`），内容就一行：

```json
{ "apiKey": "sk-你的Key" }
```

> 这个文件插件**每次调用都会重新读**，所以换 Key 不需要重启 Harness。
> 它不在插件仓库里，也不会被提交到 git（仓库的 `.gitignore` 已排除）。

**方式 ②：环境变量（适合多个 profile 共用）**

```powershell
# Windows（永久生效，但必须重启 Harness）
setx AGNES_API_KEY "sk-你的Key"
```

```sh
# macOS / Linux
export AGNES_API_KEY="sk-你的Key"     # 写进 ~/.bashrc 或 ~/.zshrc 可长期生效
```

> ⚠️ 环境变量**只在程序启动时读一次**，所以设完**必须重启 Harness**。

**方式 ③：写在插件配置里（适合只有这一个 profile）**

编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/<你的profile>/cordis.patch.yml`，加入：

```yaml
- id: agnes-image
  name: dsh-agnes-image
  config:
    apiKey: sk-你的Key
```

> ⚠️ 这种写法会让 Key 留在配置文件里。如果这个文件会被同步或备份到别处，请改用方式 ①。

---

### 第 5 步：重启 Harness

改完配置后重启一次（桌面版注意：**点窗口右上角的 X 只是最小化到托盘**，要**右键托盘图标 → 退出**，再打开）。

> 只有用「方式 ① 密钥文件」时才可以跳过这步。

---

### 第 6 步：验证

对 Harness 说一句：

> 画一张：一只戴耳机的小熊猫在画画，扁平插画风格

✅ **成功的标志**（三个都对才算成功）：

1. 它**没有**说「我没有画图能力」，而是去调用了 `agnes_generate_image`
2. 图片**直接显示在对话里**
3. 工作目录下出现 `generated-images/<今天日期>/xxx.png`

❌ 如果报 `Agnes API key is missing` → 回第 4 步，换方式 ①
❌ 如果报 `401 / 403` → Key 值不对（多半填了名字），重新复制
❌ 如果压根没这个工具 → 回第 3 步，并**完全退出** Harness 再打开

---

## 怎么用

### 直接说话就行

你不需要记参数、不需要背命令。这几种说法它都能听懂：

- 「画一张海边日落的壁纸，16:9」
- 「来个插画：一只猫在开视频会议」
- 「给 README 配个头图，扁平风」
- 「把 `D:\shots\room.png` 改成雨夜赛博朋克，保留构图」
- 「用这两张图合成一张海报，第一张是主角，第二张是产品」

### 想精确控制？把参数说给它听

| 参数 | 怎么用 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | **必填**，描述画面。写得越具体越好 | — |
| `size` | 清晰度档位：`1K`（快）/ `2K`（清晰）/ `3K` / `4K`；也可写死尺寸如 `1024x768` | `1K` |
| `ratio` | 比例：`1:1` `3:4` `4:3` `16:9` `9:16` `2:3` `3:2` `21:9` | `1:1` |
| `model` | `agnes-image-2.5-flash`（默认，最新最强）/ `2.1-flash` / `2.0-flash` | 2.5 |
| `image` | 参考图：**本地路径**、公网链接、或 `data:image/...` | 无 |
| `outputName` | 指定文件名（不含扩展名） | 提示词自动生成 |

大白话对照：

| 你想要 | 就这么说 |
|---|---|
| 手机壁纸 | 「竖版，9:16」 |
| 电脑壁纸 | 「横版，16:9，2K」 |
| 头像 / 图标 | 「1:1，1K」 |
| 快一点 | 「1K 就行」 |
| 高清一点 | 「2K」|

### 三种玩法的区别

| 玩法 | 你需要给什么 | 插件怎么发请求 |
|---|---|---|
| **文生图** | 只说描述 | 只带 `prompt`（+ 尺寸比例） |
| **图生图** | 描述 + **一张**参考图（路径或链接） | 参考图放进 `image` |
| **多图合成** | 描述 + **多张**参考图 | 多张按顺序放进 `image`，顺序 = 你说的「第一张、第二张」 |

> 本地图片会被读出来换成 base64 再发出去（这是接口的要求）。
> **只支持 PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF 四种格式，单张最大 12 MB** —— 超大图先压缩一下。

### 出图尺寸对照表

| 比例 | 1K | 2K | 3K | 4K |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `1:1` | 1024x1024 | 2048x2048 | 3072x3072 | 4096x4096 |
| `3:4` | 864x1152 | 1728x2304 | 2592x3456 | 3456x4608 |
| `4:3` | 1152x864 | 2304x1728 | 3456x2592 | 4608x3456 |
| `16:9` | 1312x736 | 2624x1472 | 3936x2208 | 5248x2944 |
| `9:16` | 736x1312 | 1472x2624 | 2208x3936 | 2944x5248 |
| `2:3` | 832x1248 | 1664x2496 | 2496x3744 | 3328x4992 |
| `3:2` | 1248x832 | 2496x1664 | 3744x2496 | 4992x3328 |
| `21:9` | 1568x672 | 3136x1344 | 4704x2016 | 6272x2688 |

> 想要 `1920x1080` / `2560x1440` 这种显示器分辨率？请用 **`2K` + `16:9`**，再自己裁剪。
> 直接写 `1920x1080` 会被服务端吸附到最接近的标准档位（画质不受损，只是尺寸不同）。

### 提示词怎么写（官方建议的模板）

| 场景 | 模板 |
|---|---|
| 文生图 | `[主体] + [场景/环境] + [风格] + [光照] + [构图] + [质量要求]` |
| 图生图 | `[改动要求] + [新风格/场景] + [要加/要去的元素] + [必须保留的元素]` |
| 多图合成 | 说明每张图的角色 + 图与图的关系 + 目标风格与构图 |

举例（图生图）：**把白天街道改成赛博朋克雨夜，加霓虹招牌和湿地面反光，同时保留街道布局、相机角度和主要建筑形状。**

---

## 安全与隐私（建议花两分钟看完）

### 你的 Key 会被怎么处理

- 插件只把 Key 放进 HTTP 请求头 `Authorization: Bearer ...` 发给**你配置的 `baseUrl`**（默认是 Agnes 官方地址）
- **不会**写进日志、不会回显在对话里、不会写进生成的图片
- 报错信息里只会出现「去哪里放 Key」的**路径**，不会出现 Key 本身

### 你的图片和提示词去哪了

- 提示词、参考图、生成的图片都会经过 **Agnes 的服务器**（这是云端服务的工作原理）
- 生成结果的下载链接指向 Agnes 的对象存储，插件拿到后会立刻下载到本地
- **不想让某张图上传？那就别把它当参考图**。插件不会自动上传你工作区里的任何文件

### 本地文件什么时候会被读出来发出去

**只有**你（或模型替你）在 `image` 参数里**明确写出路径**时，插件才会读那个文件。为了防手滑和防提示词注入，插件做了三道闸：

1. 读出来先按**文件头**确认是图片（PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF），不是图片直接拒绝
   —— 所以就算有人骗模型传 `~/.ssh/id_rsa`，也不会被当成「参考图」发出去
2. 单张上限 **12 MB**，超了直接报错（本地文件要以 base64 内联，太大既慢又没意义）
3. `data:` 开头的内容只接受 **`data:image/...;base64,`**，其它类型一律拒绝

下载回来的图片同样有三道闸：只接受 `http(s)` 地址、有**64 MB** 体积上限、响应内容按文件头/`Content-Type` 确认是图片才写入磁盘。

### 关于会话记录

DSH 会把对话原文存在本地（`~/.dsh/sessions/`）。**你在对话里粘贴过的 Key 也在里面**。所以：

- 不要把 `~/.dsh/sessions/` 提交到任何 git 仓库（本插件的安装已在 `~/.dsh/.gitignore` 里加了忽略规则）
- 要彻底清理：去 Agnes 控制台**吊销旧 Key** 并新建一个，然后更新你的密钥文件

### 插件自己对系统的权限

它是一个普通的 DSH 插件：**只做两件事**——发 HTTP 请求、往工作区写图片文件。不执行 shell 命令、不 eval 代码、不装额外依赖、不读工作区以外的文件（除非你在 `image` 里指名）。

---

## 常见问题 FAQ

**Q：要花钱吗？**
A：插件本身免费开源；Agnes 的图像模型目前免费（官方定价页标注 `$0`）。以官方页面为准。

**Q：一定要说「画一张」开头吗？**
A：不用。「来个……」「配张图」「把这张改成……」都行，只要意图是出图/改图。

**Q：必须联网吗？**
A：必须。图片是在云端生成的。

**Q：能一次生成好几张吗？**
A：一次调用返回一张。想多张就多说几次，或者直接说「给我 3 个不同版本」，模型会自己调多次。

**Q：图存哪儿了？会不会找不到？**
A：存在**你当前会话的工作目录**下的 `generated-images/<日期>/`，文件名带时间戳。想换地方就改配置项 `outputDir`。

**Q：可以画真实人物/品牌 logo 吗？**
A：技术上可以描述，但请注意版权、肖像权和服务商的内容政策，别生成违规内容。

**Q：能改我已有的照片吗？**
A：可以（图生图）。把文件路径或链接一起给它就行。

**Q：之前那张图还能再改一次吗？**
A：能，它就在你的工作目录里。把那个路径再给它，或者直接用 `@` 引用文件。

**Q：生成的图有署名/水印吗？**
A：插件不加水印；Agnes 侧的默认行为以服务商为准。

---

## 出错了？症状对照表

**先做这三件事**（能解决 80% 的问题）：

1. **完全退出 Harness 再打开**（桌面版右键托盘 → 退出，点 X 只是最小化）
2. **确认 Key 读到了**：让 AI 看一下 `~/.dsh/agnes-image.config.json` 里有没有 `apiKey`
3. **确认网络通**：`curl https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1/models -H "Authorization:

plugins.description: Command Code 订阅（Go/GOAT/Pro/Max）接入 DeepSeek Harness：档位过滤不隐藏任何模型、可视化配置 API Key、底部用量环、图片输入
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-commandcode-plans-provider

[English](README.en.md) · [第三方声明](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)

让 **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** 直接使用 **Command Code 订阅**（Go / GOAT / Pro / Max）里的模型 —— **不需要安装 Command Code CLI**，也不需要 Provider API。

- **实时模型目录**：启动时拉取，按档位过滤，**默认不隐藏任何模型**
- **模型名标注上下文容量**：`Claude Sonnet 5.5 [1M]`、`GPT-5.5 [400K]`、`Kimi K2.7 Code [256K]`
- **逐模型「推理等级」**：只列出该模型真实支持的档位
- **可视化配置 API Key**：在插件卡片里粘贴保存即可，不用手改任何配置文件
- **底部用量环**：5 小时窗口占用 + 重置倒计时（≥90% 转红），点击展开周窗口与余额
- **图片输入、工具调用、流式输出**

---

## 为什么需要这个插件

Command Code 的订阅分两类：

| 类型 | 接入方式 |
| --- | --- |
| **Provider API** 计划 | 提供标准 OpenAI 兼容端点，dsh 原生就能接，**不需要本插件** |
| **Go / GOAT / Pro / Max 订阅** | 调用 OpenAI 兼容端点会返回 `403 upgrade_required`，**只能走私有 CLI 网关** `POST /alpha/generate` |

本插件复刻那个私有网关的协议 —— 请求信封、逐行 JSON 流、事件映射 —— 把订阅变成一个 dsh 原生 provider。

**所以不需要额外安装任何东西**：那个网关就是普通的 HTTP + JSON，官方 CLI 只是它的一个客户端而已。

---

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:freeqin123/dsh-commandcode-plans-provider
```

> 如果报 `ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT`，说明你的 profile 目录是一个 pnpm 工作区，加上 `-w` 即可：
>
> ```sh
> dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:freeqin123/dsh-commandcode-plans-provider
> ```

装完**重启 dsh**。插件列表里会出现本插件（bundle id 为 `commandcode-plans-provider`）。

---

## 配置 API Key

在 dsh 里进入 **插件 → 本插件 → 配置**：

```
API 密钥   [粘贴你的 key]                    [保存] [清除]
           ● 已保存（来源：file）· user_xxxx…ABCD

套餐档位   ( Go ) ( GOAT ) ( Pro ) ( ●Max )
           显示该档位及更低档位 · 配置状态 ready

           [测试连接]   网关可达 · 5 小时用量 0%
```

几点说明：

- 密钥写进 dsh 的**凭据库**（引用名 `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY`），不写进设置文档
- **读路径不返回明文** —— 这是 dsh 凭据服务的设计（*"Secret values cross in one direction only"*）。所以界面只显示**掩码指纹** `user_xxxx…ABCD`，用来确认"当前用的到底是哪把 key"，而不是把密钥显示出来
- **测试连接**会真的拿你的 key 打一次计费接口，成功/失败都给出原文（例如 key 失效会显示上游的 `401`）
- 不想用界面也可以：把 `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` 写进 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`，或设为环境变量

---

## 使用

### 1. 选模型

**设置 → 模型 → Command Code**，然后选一个模型。名字后面的 `[1M]` 就是它的上下文容量，取自模型列表接口的 `context_length`（真实逐模型值，不是固定值）。

### 2. 选档位

在插件卡片里点档位按钮。语义是「**显示该档位及以下包含的全部模型**」：

| 档位 | 显示范围 |
| --- | --- |
| Go | 所有 Go 模型 |
| GOAT | 所有 Go + GOAT 模型 |
| Pro | 所有 Go + GOAT + Pro 模型 |
| **Max（默认）** | 全部（凡 catalog 标了已知档位的模型） |

**默认 `max` + 「档位未知的模型也显示」两者合起来 = 开箱不隐藏任何模型。**

这是刻意的设计：不少同类实现默认档位是 `go`，导致 GOAT 用户看不到自己有权使用的模型。

### 3. 推理等级

模型选择器里的「推理等级」由本插件**逐模型**填充，列出**该模型真实支持的档位**（来自官方 CLI catalog 的 `Efforts` 列，比如 `Low / Medium / High / X-High / Max`）。

另有 `Off` —— 它表示**不发送** `reasoning_effort` 字段，也就是让模型自己决定。

如果某个模型没有推理等级可选，选择器会显示"当前模型未提供推理等级"，这也是真实情况。

### 4. 用量

底部 composer 那一行会多出一个环：

```
Command Code ◯ 34%  2h13m
```

- 环 = **5 小时窗口**的占用比例
- **≥90% 转红**，用于提前发现"快用满了"
- 后面跟**重置倒计时**
- **点击展开**：5 小时 / 周窗口 / 余额，以及各自的已用值与上限

> 注意：5 小时窗口用了 0% 时环是空的一圈，这是正常的，不是坏了。

### 5. 图片

支持视觉的模型可以直接贴图。

按官方 CLI 的分类，**DeepSeek / GLM / Qwen / MiniMax / Grok 4.6 等是纯文本模型**，给它们贴图会被**明确拒绝**（不是静默丢弃 —— 静默丢图会让你以为模型"看不见"是它笨）。换 Claude 或 Grok 4.5 这类模型即可。

关于图片有两个设计事实值得知道：

1. **网关是无状态的**：不保存图片，也没有上传接口。所以**每轮都要把整段历史里的图片重新内联发送**（官方 CLI 同样是这个行为）。这意味着同一张图在第 3 轮对话里仍要再付一次开销。
2. **有总预算**：一轮里内联的 base64 总量超过 `maxRequestImageBytes`（默认 2 MiB）时，插件**不发请求**，而是要求 dsh 先把**最旧的**图片 offload 掉再重试。所以没有图片会被无声地丢弃。

---

## 已知限制

- **用的是未公开接口**：`/alpha/generate` 是 Command Code 的私有网关，官方随时可能改动或封禁。本项目与 Command Code 无任何关联。
- **必须有订阅**：没有订阅的话 Provider API 那条路本来就够用，不需要本插件。
- **单账号**：不支持多账号并行。
- **暂无自动重试**：遇到 `RATE_LIMIT` 会直接把错误报出来，不会自动退避重试（网关前面有 Cloudflare 并发限流，多开几个会话可能触发）。
- **图片重复内联**：见上文，长对话里图片多会明显增加开销。

---

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 先看哪里 |
| --- | --- |
| 底部环一直是 `—` | 宿主日志里 `[commandcode-plans-provider]` 开头的行 |
| 模型列表为空 | 日志里的扫描结果。模型列表接口失败时会**保留上次目录**而不是清空 |
| `401` | key 失效了，重新贴一把 |
| `403 upgrade_required` | 版本头过期。插件会自动失效缓存并重试一次；仍失败请提 issue |
| `RATE_LIMIT` | 网关限流，稍后再试 |
| 贴图被拒 | 该模型按官方分类是纯文本，换支持视觉的模型 |
| `Command Code 对话接入尚未完成` | dsh 没重启 —— 宿主代码改动必须重启进程才生效 |

日志位置：`~/.dsh/logs/`，或者直接看你启动 dsh 的那个终端窗口。

---

## 开发

```sh
npm install
npm run verify   # 类型检查 + 编译 + 三个冒烟测试
```

```
src/                宿主半边
  index.ts            配置、目录扫描、定时重扫、注册 provider / 适配器 / 用量命名空间
  catalog.ts          双源模型目录、档位策略、图片能力判定、上下文标签
  plan-tier.ts        档位定义与 planId 映射
  protocol.ts         /alpha/generate 信封、逐行 JSON 解析、事件 → StreamChunk 映射
  adapter.ts          LlmAdapter 实现（listModels / resolveModel / stream）
  cli-version.ts      x-command-code-version 动态解析（缓存 + 回退 + 过期重试）
  usage.ts            用量与限额接口
  remote.ts           Remote 服务控制器
  typert.ts           把命名空间注册到 Typert 注册表
client/index.js     浏览器半边：底部用量环 + 插件配置卡
scripts/            三个离线冒烟测试（客户端加载 / 目录解析 / 协议映射）
```

**`lib/` 是故意提交进仓库的** —— dsh 直接从 `lib/index.js` 加载，而从 `github:` 安装不会执行构建步骤。改完源码记得跑一次 `npm run build` 再提交。

三个冒烟测试都不联网，但覆盖的是真会出错的契约：客户端半边能否加载（曾经有一版错误让整个 Web UI 起不来）、catalog 列序被调换后档位是否仍正确、流式映射的块开闭与用量去重不变量。

---

## Credit

协议层源自 **[brent-weatherall/opencode-commandcode-provider](https://github.com/brent-weatherall/opencode-commandcode-provider)**（MIT，Copyright © 2026 Brent Weatherall）。那是一个给 opencode 实现同样能力的项目。

本项目是它在 dsh 上的重写：请求信封结构、逐行 JSON 流的事件映射、工具调用与图片的转换规则、纯文本模型名单等，均沿用其契约。按 MIT 要求，上游版权声明已保留在 [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) 中。

plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：在侧边栏左下角账号栏那一行的右侧加一个设置齿轮按钮，一键直达设置页。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-better-settings

> 仓库：<https://github.com/W0rry628/dsh-better-settings> · 变更记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：在侧边栏左下角**账号栏那一行的右侧**加一个设置齿轮按钮，
一键打开设置面板 —— 不必再「点开账号菜单 → 点设置」两步走。

```
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│  … 会话列表 …                │
│                             │
│  [头像] 账号名           ⚙  │   ← 这个齿轮是本插件加的
└─────────────────────────────┘
```

## 它做了什么

- 挂载后找到侧边栏底部的设置行（ui-settings-general 的 `triggerRow`），
  把齿轮按钮追加到该行最右侧，紧跟在连接状态、更新提示之后。
- 点击时优先复用外壳自己注入的 `openSettings`（`settings.launcher` 的注入物，
  账号菜单拿到的就是它），因此打开的是原生设置面板，不模拟点击、不闪菜单。
- 跟随界面语言切换 `设置 / Settings` 文案；tooltip 里带上当前生效的
  `settings.open` 快捷键（如 `Ctrl+,`）。
- 侧边栏收起成 56px 轨道时自动隐藏（那一行只有 36px 宽，放不下第二个按钮）。
- 如果所在部署里那一行**本来就有**内置设置按钮（没有账号插件接管
  `settings.launcher`），则不加重复按钮。

## 为什么用 DOM 挂载而不是 Slot

DSH 的插槽清单里，侧边栏底部只有两个口：

| Slot | 位置 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | 设置行**上方**独立的一行 | 「Optional actions beside Settings at the sidebar foot」，`footArea` 是纵向列 |
| `sidebar.settings` | 账号栏所在的那一行 | `single`，占用者是 ui-settings-general 的整行；内部**没有**留给第三方按钮的插槽 |

那一行内部的结构是 `[settings.launcher（账号菜单）] [ConnectionIndicator] [DesktopUpdateIndicator]`，
想把自己的按钮放在账号栏**右侧**，只能挂到该行末尾。所以这里采用社区插件
（dshmarket、dsh-ui-tweaks）在同类无插槽场景下的做法：认领一个带自有标记的
DOM 节点、用 MutationObserver 跟随重排，并在卸载时完整回收。

如果只想放在「设置行上方那一行」，那把 `lib/client.js` 里的挂载逻辑换成注册
`sidebar.footer.action` 插槽即可，那是一条更稳定（但位置不同）的路。

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'github:W0rry628/dsh-better-settings'
```

也可以直接在 DSH 的插件管理器 / 插件市场里装。

本地开发（把仓库克隆到本机任意目录）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/绝对路径/dsh-better-settings
```

手工等价操作：

1. 在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里加：
   `"dsh-better-settings": "github:W0rry628/dsh-better-settings"`（本地开发写
   `"file:/绝对路径/dsh-better-settings"`）。
2. 把 `"dsh-better-settings"` 追加到同文件 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组末尾
   （顺序即 patch 层应用顺序）。
3. 在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`。
4. 重启 DSH 桌面版（客户端半边是新的模块，热更新只在 `dev:web` 同时运行时生效）。


## 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | 包清单：`dsh.bundle.patch`（bundle 层）+ `dsh.client`（浏览器半边） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch：把 `dsh-better-settings` 这一行插进 profile 配置树 |
| `lib/index.js` | 服务端半边：不做任何事，只是为了这一行能被正常加载 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半边：全部功能都在这里 |
| `test/client-smoke.mjs` | 假 DOM 冒烟测试：验证落位、去重、轨道态隐藏与卸载回收 |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | 版本变更记录 |

## 测试

```sh
node test/client-smoke.mjs
```

## 已知限制

- 依赖 `triggerRow` 的 CSS Module 类名子串与 `aria-haspopup` 语义来定位行；
  DSH 若改掉这两个约定，需要同步更新 `findTriggerRow` / `findLauncher`。
- 打开设置时优先走 React fiber 上注入的 `openSettings`；React 内部结构若变化，
  会自动退回「点开账号菜单 → 点设置」的兜底路径。
- 收起轨道态不显示按钮。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: push a local folder to GitHub in one sentence - proxy autodetect, gh auth self-heal, pre-push secret gate, SHA read-back verification.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-github-push

> DeepSeek Harness 插件：**一句话把本地目录推送到 GitHub**。

注册一个模型工具 `github_push`。你对 Agent 说「把这个项目开源到 GitHub」，它就能走完全程：
探测代理 → 自愈 gh 登录态 → 扫描密钥与个人信息 → 建仓/提交/推送 → 回读远端 SHA 校验。

内核来自 [outbox](https://github.com/imcaibaicai/outbox) 项目，本仓库是它的**发布产物**（内嵌内核由
`scripts/sync-plugin.mjs` 自动同步，不是手写的第二实现）。

## 它替你挡掉了什么

| 常见故障 | 处理方式 |
|---|---|
| `gh` 突然报未登录，但 `git push` 明明正常 | 登录态文件会被清空，token 却还在系统凭据管理器里 —— 自动取回并重新校验 |
| 代理时通时不通，或关掉代理后命令卡死 | 先探测 `127.0.0.1:7890`：通则**按次注入**，不通则只清掉指向该端口的陈旧变量后直连 |
| 推到一半卡在输密码 | 子进程一律禁止交互询问，宁可明确失败也不静默挂起 |
| 密钥被推上公开仓库 | 推送前扫描**即将提交的索引**，命中高危内容直接阻断并列出文件与行号 |
| 命令返回 0，但推的其实是旧东西 | 回读远端分支，要求**远端 SHA 严格等于本地 HEAD** 才算成功 |
| 仓库里写死了本机用户目录路径 | 扫描绝对路径中的用户名、身份证号、手机号等，命中后**禁止自动公开** |

## 工具契约：`github_push`

| 参数 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `dir` | ✅ | 要发布的目录，**必须是绝对路径** |
| `visibility` | ✅ | `public` / `private` / `ask` |
| `name` | | 远端仓库名，默认由目录名规整而来 |
| `description` | | 仓库描述 |
| `message` | | 提交信息 |
| `dryRun` | | 只预检，不提交不推送 |

**可见性规则（刻意设计成不能由模型代劳）**：用户明确说公开/开源才传 `public`；
明确说私有才传 `private`；**其它情况一律 `ask`** —— 此时工具不会创建任何远端仓库，
只做预检并返回需要确认的问题，由 Agent 拿去问用户。

安全闸门命中个人信息时，即使请求了 `public` 也会停下来要求逐条确认。

## 安装

本插件是标准的 DSH host 插件（在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里插一行 loader 行）。
把包放进 profile 的 `node_modules`，然后加一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: github-push
      name: 'dsh-github-push'
```

**host 插件在启动时装载，必须完全退出 DSH 再重启才生效。**

> 不想装插件也行：同一份内核还有命令行外壳与 Agent 通用 `SKILL.md`，见 [outbox](https://github.com/imcaibaicai/outbox)。

## 相关项目

- [outbox](https://github.com/imcaibaicai/outbox) —— 内核本体，同时提供 CLI 与 Agent 通用 Skill
- [dsh-plugin-publish](https://github.com/suyukun/dsh-plugin-publish) —— 面向 Agent 技能的发布流程协议，与本插件互补

## License

MIT
